description: Public text and complete schema contract. The four shared workflow notices are fingerprinted separately. The three save tools include reviewed optional meeting_id and shared append guidance. Inspect/recall metadata and knowledge-first guidance distinguish explicit additions from saved-document reuse. Append guidance is fingerprinted separately. Other tool metadata, environment help, model text and the read response retain earlier baselines. SHA-256 over canonical JSON. The default knowledge path is normalized for portability. No events or tools were executed.
